## feature

### CLI executable renamed from pairmerge to pairloom

```
level: medium
```

#### reason

Medium: a user-visible surface change (command name, message prefixes, BAM
program headers) with repo-wide but mechanical scope, executed at the
user's explicit instruction and without keeping an alias.

#### description

```
type: text
```

1. `pyproject.toml` `[project.scripts]` now maps `pairloom` (was
   `pairmerge`) to `pairloom.cli:main`.
2. `src/pairloom/cli.py` uses `prog="pairloom"`; every note, warning, and
   error prefix reads `pairloom:`.
3. `src/pairloom/pipeline.py` stderr prefixes and the `@PG` header records
   (`ID`/`PN`/`CL`) use `pairloom`, so the done-line, backup warnings, and
   BAM provenance all carry the new name.
4. Tests, README, AGENTS.md, the pixi `cli` task, and
   `data/synthetic/EXPECTED.md` follow; the pixi env was refreshed so the
   console script exists only under the new name.

#### before

```text
pyproject.toml: pairmerge = "pairloom.cli:main"
prog="pairmerge"; stderr "pairmerge: done. ..." / "pairmerge: error: ..."
BAM @PG: ID:pairmerge PN:pairmerge CL:pairmerge mode=...
pairmerge --version -> "pairmerge 0.1.0"
```

#### after

```text
pyproject.toml: pairloom = "pairloom.cli:main"
prog="pairloom"; stderr "pairloom: done. ..." / "pairloom: error: ..."
BAM @PG: ID:pairloom PN:pairloom CL:pairloom mode=...
pairloom --version -> "pairloom 0.1.0"
shutil.which("pairmerge") -> None in the pixi env
```

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: text
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
```
pixi install -> default env installed
which("pairloom") -> .pixi/envs/default/bin/pairloom
which("pairmerge") -> None
pairloom --version -> pairloom 0.1.0
regeneration stderr -> "pairloom: done. total=5, ... merge-reasons={'fragment_gap': 1}"
git grep pairmerge (excluding docs/plans, docs/misc) -> no matches
```
:::

## caveat

### BAM outputs change at the byte level via the @PG header

```
level: low
```

#### reason

Low: intended provenance change, but anyone byte-diffing outputs across
versions will see it and should know why.

#### description

```
type: text
```

Every BAM PairLoom writes now embeds `@PG ID:pairloom PN:pairloom`. The
committed synthetic expected BAMs were regenerated in the same change;
only those `@PG` bytes differ (each file grew by 2 bytes under BGZF).
Parquet outputs carry no program record and are unchanged.

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: text
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
`git diff --stat data/synthetic/`: expected_merged.bam 384 -> 386 bytes,
expected_unmerged.bam 475 -> 477 bytes, EXPECTED.md 1 line; the two
parquet files absent from the diff.
:::

## observation

### Historical records keep the pairmerge name by design

```
level: low
```

#### reason

Low: prevents a future reader from "fixing" accurate history.

#### description

```
type: text
```

Entries under `docs/plans/` and `docs/misc/requirements_audit.qmd` that
predate the rename keep the name that was true when they were written;
they are records, not living documentation. The README and AGENTS.md are
the living surface and now say `pairloom`.

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: text
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
`git grep -c pairmerge -- docs/plans docs/misc` returns hits only in
historical plan/report and audit records.
:::

## process

### Plan, mechanical rename, regenerate artifacts, gate, two-commit split

```
status: right
```

#### description

```
type: text
```

1. Plan written before any edit; the `@PG` embed in the committed
   expected BAMs was identified up front, so regeneration was a planned
   step, not a post-gate surprise.
2. Rename applied mechanically across entry point, CLI, pipeline, tests,
   docs, and task definitions; `pixi install` refreshed the console
   script; expected outputs regenerated with the new binary.
3. Full gate run (182 tests, lint, format) and a tracked-source sweep
   (`git grep`) closed the loop; the stale project memory was corrected.

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: text
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
Plan: `docs/plans/20261022-135220_rename-cli-to-pairloom.plan.qmd`
(as executed); one mismatched Edit string was re-located by grep and
fixed before the gate run.
:::
